correctness.rationale: For every finite field and positive dimension/arity, commuting idempotents have the shared fixed point c=P(0); the joint eigenspaces of their commuting linear parts yield an ordered Boolean decomposition. The exact quotient V/V_allones counts translations; GL orbit-stabilizer counts labelled summands. The GL order factorization and completion-of-squares identity give the exact discrete Gaussian weights. A bounded positive infinite GL product and summable quadratic lattice envelope rigorously justify the theta equivalent, total variation and probability exponent. Eleven exhaustive finite computations over fields of size 2,3,4 independently corroborate exact counts, but do not prove infinite statements.
